build_graph_network: build a GraphNetwork model with custom edge, node, and global update functions for message passing
create_interaction_network: create an InteractionNetwork that updates edges from sender/receiver node features and aggregates to nodes
build_gat_layer: build a Graph Attention Network layer with attention query function, logit function, and optional node update
build_gcn_layer: build a Graph Convolutional Network layer with symmetric normalization and optional self edges
create_deep_sets: create a DeepSets model that updates nodes from globals and aggregates nodes to globals for set processing
